color_palette.name: GeoCities Grape
color_palette.usage: Primary site background — a deep web-safe purple evoking late-90s GeoCities page backgrounds; anchors the tiled-wallpaper aesthetic across all page surfaces and dashboard panels

color_palette.name: Netscape Lime
color_palette.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active filter states, hit-counter widgets, and beveled button highlights; the electric lime screams browser-era energy and drives every primary action across Browse Inventory and Reserve pages

color_palette.name: AOL Hot Magenta
color_palette.usage: Hero headline accents, 88x31 badge borders, rainbow rule dividers, and stat callout values on the Home and Vehicle Specs pages; clashes intentionally with Netscape Lime for maximum web-safe chaos

color_palette.name: Dial-Up Sky
color_palette.usage: Hyperlink color, visited-state underlines, metric card borders, and chart data lines across dashboard modules; the electric blue carries the functional underlined-link anchor tradition of the era

color_palette.name: Sunshine Honk
color_palette.usage: Eyebrow labels, Under Construction badge fills, sticker callouts, and price-highlight chips on inventory cards and comparison panels; web-safe yellow used as a loud secondary accent

color_palette.name: Bevel White
color_palette.usage: Raised panel surfaces, beveled button face color, metric card backgrounds, and modal/dialog surfaces; simulates the Windows 95 / Netscape chrome raised-UI feel on all dashboard product panels

color_palette.name: Browser Chrome Gray
color_palette.usage: Beveled button shadow edges, panel inset borders, table row stripes, and the recessed-border treatment on feature grid cells; the classic silver-gray of 90s desktop UI chrome

color_palette.name: Midnight Lot
color_palette.usage: Navigation bar, footer, dark hero overlay, and deep panel backgrounds; a near-black with purple undertone that ties the dark portal aesthetic together and grounds the saturated palette

typography.heading_treatment: Arial Black rendered in full shouty ALL-CAPS at large display weights — H1 at 56–72px with tight tracking (-0.02em), H2 at 36–48px, H3 at 24–30px; color alternates between Netscape Lime, AOL Hot Magenta, and Bevel White depending on surface darkness; drop-shadow text effects and hard outline strokes applied on hero and stats sections to maximize GeoCities-era visual aggression.
typography.body_treatment: Verdana at 14–16px with a 1.65 line-height and a comfortable 60–70ch measure; the wide letter-spacing native to Verdana was engineered for low-resolution screens, making it the canonical 90s web body face; used for all inventory descriptions, feature panel copy, FAQ answers, and reservation flow prose in near-white or Bevel White on dark surfaces.
typography.accent_treatment: VT323 (Google Fonts CRT terminal pixel font) at 12–14px only — strictly reserved for hit-counter readouts, metadata timestamps, badge labels, 'UNDER CONSTRUCTION' marquee strips, stat unit suffixes, and small eyebrow tags on dashboard metric cards; never used at display or body scale.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**RevvLot Home Page — Full Visual Design Direction**

**SIGNATURE MOMENT:** The hero section features a full-bleed, edge-to-edge marquee strip of the site name "REVVLOT" rendered in Arial Black at ~120px, alternating between AOL Hot Magenta and Netscape Lime, stacked in two rows and scrolling horizontally like a 90s ticker tape — it crashes through the top of the page before the navigation even settles, acting as a typographic wallpaper backdrop behind the hero content. This is unmistakably GeoCities-era maximalism: the type IS the hero image, and the pixel-art car lot illustration floats on top of it rather than beside it. This move is inevitable for the retro_90s_web aesthetic — type-as-wallpaper, neon-on-dark, zero restraint.

**SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:**
1. Hero — Maximum density, dark portal surface (Midnight Lot), marquee type backdrop, asymmetric layout with illustration dominating the right two-thirds while CTA stack anchors bottom-left. Electric, chaotic energy.
2. Stats — A full-bleed GeoCities Grape panel. Oversized numerals as display type — not cards, but a raw four-column data dashboard with stat values at 72–80px Arial Black in Netscape Lime. Sparse, punchy. Serves as a breathing beat after the hero chaos.
3. Feature Grid — Returns to density. Bevel White raised-panel cards on a Midnight Lot background, with Browser Chrome Gray inset borders. A tiled diagonal wallpaper texture behind the grid. Retro icon anchors each card. Asymmetric: 2×2 grid left-heavy with a side-column CTA strip on the right.
4. Timeline — Masthead-style horizontal strip layout. Each step is a numbered block separated by rainbow rule dividers. Background alternates between GeoCities Grape and Midnight Lot in a hard-cut stripe per step — no gradients. Step numbers are oversized VT323 digits (80px) used as structural glyphs, not body text.
5. Testimonials — Dense, multi-column "guestbook" aesthetic. Three quote blocks styled as browser window chrome panels (beveled borders, fake title bar in Browser Chrome Gray). Sunshine Honk star ratings. AOL Hot Magenta quote marks at 96px. Asymmetric alignment with quotes offset from each other vertically.

**COLOR AND SURFACE USAGE:**
- Hero: Midnight Lot background, Netscape Lime + AOL Hot Magenta for marquee type, Bevel White for subheadline prose, Sunshine Honk for eyebrow label.
- Stats: GeoCities Grape full-bleed, Netscape Lime for numerals, Bevel White for descriptors, Dial-Up Sky underline rule beneath headline.
- Feature Grid: Midnight Lot page background, Bevel White raised card faces, Browser Chrome Gray card borders and inset shadows, Netscape Lime for icon accent strokes, Sunshine Honk for eyebrow, AOL Hot Magenta for section headline.
- Timeline: Alternating GeoCities Grape / Midnight Lot hard stripes, Sunshine Honk step eyebrows, Netscape Lime step titles, Bevel White body text, rainbow rule dividers between steps.
- Testimonials: Midnight Lot background, Bevel White browser-chrome card surfaces, Browser Chrome Gray title bar strips, AOL Hot Magenta oversized quote marks, Sunshine Honk star ratings, Dial-Up Sky reviewer names as underlined links.

**TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:**
- Display / H1: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 56–72px, tight tracking (-0.02em), hard text-shadow in contrasting color. Used in hero headline and stats numerals.
- H2 section headlines: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 36–48px, alternating between AOL Hot Magenta and Netscape Lime depending on surface.
- H3 card/step titles: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 22–28px, Bevel White or Netscape Lime.
- Body: Verdana, 14–16px, 1.65 line-height, Bevel White or near-white on dark surfaces.
- Accent/metadata: VT323, 12–14px, Sunshine Honk or Dial-Up Sky — hit counters, step numbers as structural glyphs, badge labels.
- Eyebrow labels: Verdana, ALL-CAPS, 11px, letter-spacing 0.2em, Sunshine Honk background chip with Midnight Lot text.

**DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:**
Hero and testimonials are high-density with layered elements. Stats is intentionally sparse — four numbers on a flat grape field, maximum breathing room. Feature grid returns to medium-high density with tight card gutters. Timeline is structured and rhythmic, not dense. The page breathes in a dense → sparse → dense → rhythmic → dense pattern to prevent visual fatigue while maintaining 90s maximalist energy throughout.

**RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:**
- Hero: Marquee type scales down to 60px on tablet, 36px on mobile. Illustration drops behind text on mobile (background position). CTA stack goes full-width.
- Stats: 4-column → 2-column → 1-column stacked. Numerals scale from 72px → 48px → 40px.
- Feature Grid: 2×2 grid → 2-column → 1-column. Side CTA strip moves below grid on tablet/mobile.
- Timeline: Horizontal strip → vertical stacked steps on mobile. Rainbow dividers become horizontal rules.
- Testimonials: 3-column → 1-column stacked. Quote panels maintain full browser-chrome treatment at all sizes.

**FIT WITH SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM:**
All color tokens drawn strictly from the 8-color palette. Typography uses only Arial Black (heading), Verdana (body), and VT323 (accent) as specified. The beveled button treatment, rainbow rule dividers, 88×31 badge motifs, and hit-counter widget in VT323 appear across the page as recurring structural devices, not decorative afterthoughts. The page establishes the visual language that Browse Inventory and Vehicle Specs will inherit.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
**HERO SECTION — Home Section 1**

Surface: Full-bleed Midnight Lot (#110022) background. Behind all content, two rows of the word 'REVVLOT' in Arial Black at 120px scroll horizontally as a marquee ticker — row 1 in AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC), row 2 in Netscape Lime (#00FF33) — set at roughly 25% opacity so they read as a typographic wallpaper texture rather than foreground text. This is the page's SIGNATURE MOMENT: type-as-backdrop, pure GeoCities-era excess. The marquee rows are full-width and positioned in the upper half of the hero, behind all other elements.

Layout: The hero is 100vw × 90vh minimum. Content sits in a 12-column grid. The eyebrow label, headline, subheadline, and CTA stack are anchored to the BOTTOM-LEFT quadrant (columns 1–5), vertically bottom-aligned with roughly 64px padding from the page bottom edge. The pixel-art car lot illustration (retro neon lot at night, REVVLOT sign, string lights, rows of cars) occupies the RIGHT two-thirds of the hero (columns 5–12), positioned as an absolute overlay that bleeds to the right edge and bottom edge of the hero — it is NOT contained in a box, it floats over the marquee backdrop. This asymmetric placement creates structural tension and avoids the centered split-hero cliché.

Eyebrow: 'WELCOME TO THE LOT' — Verdana, 11px, ALL-CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em, rendered as a Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) filled chip/badge with Midnight Lot (#110022) text. Positioned top-left of the content column, 8px bottom margin before headline.

Headline: 'FIND YOUR NEXT RIDE. NO HAGGLING REQUIRED.' — Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 64px, tight tracking (-0.02em), rendered in Bevel White (#E8E8E8) with a hard 3px AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) text-shadow offset at 3px 3px 0. Two lines, left-aligned. The period after each sentence is in Netscape Lime (#00FF33) as a typographic accent.

Subheadline: 'Thousands of inspected, priced-right used cars — browsed from your couch, reserved in minutes.' — Verdana, 16px, 1.65 line-height, Bevel White (#E8E8E8), left-aligned, max-width ~480px, 16px top margin.

CTAs: Two beveled 3D buttons stacked horizontally with 16px gap, 24px top margin. Primary: 'BROWSE THE INVENTORY' — Netscape Lime (#00FF33) face, Midnight Lot text, Arial Black 14px, beveled top/left edge in Bevel White (#E8E8E8), beveled bottom/right edge in Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0), simulating a raised Windows 95 button. Secondary: 'HOW IT WORKS' — Bevel White face, Midnight Lot text, same bevel treatment. Both buttons have 12px vertical / 24px horizontal padding.

Bottom-right corner of the hero: an 88×31 sticker badge reading 'BEST USED CARS ONLINE' with a Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) border and Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) fill, positioned overlapping the illustration's lower-right corner.

A rainbow rule divider (6 horizontal stripes: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, each 3px tall) runs full-width at the very bottom of the hero section as a structural separator.

Illustration placement: The pixel-art car lot illustration is placed as a large (roughly 700px wide on desktop) absolutely positioned element in the right portion of the hero, with its bottom edge flush with the hero bottom edge. It overlaps the marquee text backdrop and sits behind the CTA stack. This placement reinforces the 90s web aesthetic where images were layered chaotically over backgrounds rather than contained in clean boxes.

**STATS SECTION — Home Section 2**

Surface: Full-bleed GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) panel. No tiling, no texture — a flat, saturated grape field that creates a hard color break from the Midnight Lot hero. This is the sparse breathing beat in the page rhythm.

Layout: 12-column grid, full-width. Section padding: 80px top/bottom. The section headline and eyebrow sit centered at the top. Below them, four stat blocks are laid out in a single row of four equal columns (3 columns each in a 12-col grid), with no card borders or raised panels — the stats float directly on the grape surface.

Eyebrow: 'BY THE NUMBERS' — Verdana, 11px, ALL-CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) chip badge, centered, 16px bottom margin.

Headline: 'THE LOT DOESN'T LIE' — Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 48px, centered, Bevel White (#E8E8E8) text. A Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) underline rule (4px solid, full headline width) sits 8px below the headline text — this is a structural device, not a decorative afterthought. 40px margin below before stat blocks.

Stat blocks (×4): Each block is centered within its column. The stat value ('12,400+', '98%', '48 Hours', '50 States') is rendered in Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 72–80px, Netscape Lime (#00FF33) with a hard 2px AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) text-shadow at 2px 2px 0. Below each value, the description text ('Vehicles currently listed across all makes and models', etc.) is Verdana, 14px, Bevel White (#E8E8E8), centered, max-width ~180px, 1.5 line-height. A VT323 12px Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) label reading 'STAT' appears above each value as a tiny eyebrow tag in the hit-counter/badge tradition.

Between each stat column, a thin vertical Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) rule (1px, 60% column height, vertically centered) acts as a column separator in the classic 90s table-layout tradition.

No CTA in this section. No illustration. The section's power comes entirely from the oversized numerals on the flat grape field — maximum contrast, maximum legibility, zero decoration beyond the structural Dial-Up Sky underline.

Responsive: 4-col → 2×2 grid on tablet → 1-column stacked on mobile. Numerals scale: 72px → 48px → 40px. Vertical separators hidden on mobile.

**FEATURE GRID SECTION — Home Section 3**

Surface: Midnight Lot (#110022) background. A subtle tiled diagonal pattern (repeating 45° hatching in GeoCities Grape at 8% opacity) overlays the background to evoke GeoCities tiled wallpaper without overwhelming the card content.

Layout: 12-column grid. Section padding: 80px top, 64px bottom. The section is split asymmetrically: columns 1–8 contain the 2×2 feature card grid; columns 9–12 contain a narrow right-column CTA strip. This asymmetry breaks the standard 3-equal-column feature section.

Eyebrow: 'WHY REVVLOT' — Verdana, 11px, ALL-CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) chip badge, left-aligned above headline, 12px bottom margin.

Headline: 'WE BUILT THE DEALERSHIP WE ALWAYS WANTED' — Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 42px, AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) with a hard 3px Bevel White (#E8E8E8) text-shadow at 2px 2px 0, left-aligned, max-width ~600px, 8px bottom margin.

Subheadline: 'Transparent pricing. Honest history. A reservation system that actually works.' — Verdana, 15px, Bevel White (#E8E8E8), left-aligned, 32px bottom margin.

Feature Cards (2×2 grid, 16px gutter): Each card is a raised Bevel White (#E8E8E8) panel with a 3px Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) border on all sides, plus a 2px inset shadow on top/left edges in Bevel White and a 2px inset shadow on bottom/right edges in a darker gray (#808080) — simulating the Windows 95 raised-panel bevel effect. Card padding: 24px. Card background: Bevel White (#E8E8E8).

Each card contains: (1) Retro line icon (wrench+checkmark, price tag+star, vintage key, or document+timeline) at 40×40px, Netscape Lime (#00FF33) stroke on Midnight Lot fill, positioned top-left of card. (2) Card title in Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 18px, Midnight Lot (#110022) text, 12px top margin below icon. (3) Description in Verdana, 13px, #333333 (dark gray for legibility on light surface), 1.6 line-height, 8px top margin.

The icon set (home-section-3-asset-1) is placed inside each card, top-left corner, NOT centered — this off-axis placement reinforces the amateur-charming 90s aesthetic.

Right column CTA strip (columns 9–12): A vertical Netscape Lime (#00FF33) filled strip, full height of the card grid, 24px padding. Contains: a vertical text label 'READY TO BROWSE?' in Arial Black, 14px, ALL-CAPS, Midnight Lot (#110022), rotated 90° and centered vertically. Below (or at bottom of strip): the CTA button 'SEE A SAMPLE LISTING' — beveled Midnight Lot face, Netscape Lime text, Arial Black 13px, same bevel treatment as hero buttons. The lime strip acts as a color block that breaks the section-background alternation and makes color do structural work.

A rainbow rule divider (same 6-stripe, 3px-each treatment as hero) runs full-width at the section bottom.

Responsive: 2×2 grid → 1-column stacked cards on mobile. Right CTA strip moves below grid, horizontal orientation, full-width.

**TIMELINE SECTION — Home Section 4**

Surface: Alternating hard-cut horizontal stripes — Step 1 on GeoCities Grape (#6600CC), Step 2 on Midnight Lot (#110022), Step 3 on GeoCities Grape (#6600CC), Step 4 on Midnight Lot (#110022). No gradients, no transitions — hard color breaks between steps, like a 90s table with alternating row colors taken to full-bleed extremes. This masthead-style horizontal strip layout is the structural move that differentiates this section from a standard card grid.

Section header: Positioned above the alternating stripe blocks on a Midnight Lot (#110022) surface with 48px top/bottom padding.
- Eyebrow: 'HOW IT WORKS' — Verdana, 11px, ALL-CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) chip, centered.
- Headline: 'FROM BROWSE TO KEYS — HERE'S THE PLAY-BY-PLAY' — Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 42px, Netscape Lime (#00FF33), centered, hard 2px AOL Hot Magenta text-shadow. 32px bottom margin.

Each step block: Full-width stripe, 72px top/bottom padding, 12-column grid.
- LEFT column (col 1–2): Oversized step number in VT323 font at 80px, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) on Grape steps, AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) on Midnight Lot steps. The number is purely structural — it acts as a large glyph anchor, NOT body text. Below the number, a small Verdana 11px ALL-CAPS label 'STEP' in Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0).
- CENTER column (col 3–9): Step title in Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 26px, Netscape Lime (#00FF33) on Midnight Lot stripes, Bevel White (#E8E8E8) on Grape stripes. Below title: description in Verdana, 15px, 1.65 line-height, Bevel White (#E8E8E8) on both surfaces, max-width ~560px.
- RIGHT column (col 10–12): Empty on steps 1, 2, 4. On Step 3 (Reserve), a small Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) chip badge reads '$99 HOLD — FULLY REFUNDABLE' in VT323 12px Midnight Lot text, centered in the right column — a callout sticker that breaks the rhythm and draws the eye.

Between each step stripe: A rainbow rule divider (6 stripes × 2px each) runs full-width as the separator — these are structural devices that mark the step transitions, not decorative afterthoughts.

CTA: After Step 4's stripe, a full-width Netscape Lime (#00FF33) bar (40px height) contains the CTA button 'START BROWSING' — beveled Midnight Lot face, Netscape Lime text, Arial Black 14px, centered in the bar. The lime bar acts as a terminal block that closes the section.

Responsive: All stripes remain full-width. Step number column stacks above content on mobile. Rainbow dividers remain. CTA bar stays full-width.

**TESTIMONIALS SECTION — Home Section 5**

Surface: Midnight Lot (#110022) background, full-width. Section padding: 80px top, 96px bottom (extra bottom padding before footer).

Layout: 12-column grid. Section header centered at top. Three testimonial panels arranged in a 3-column layout (4 columns each), but with deliberate vertical offset — the center panel is shifted DOWN by 32px relative to the left and right panels, creating an asymmetric staggered arrangement that evokes a 90s guestbook or bulletin board rather than a clean card row.

Eyebrow: 'STRAIGHT FROM THE DRIVERS' — Verdana, 11px, ALL-CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) chip, centered, 12px bottom margin.

Headline: 'DON'T TAKE OUR WORD FOR IT' — Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 48px, AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) with a hard 3px Netscape Lime (#00FF33) text-shadow at 3px 3px 0, centered. 40px bottom margin.

Testimonial panels (×3): Each panel is styled as a browser/Netscape window chrome panel:
- Outer border: 3px Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) with beveled top/left in Bevel White and beveled bottom/right in #808080 — the classic Windows dialog box border.
- Title bar strip (top of panel, 28px tall): Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) fill with a fake window title in VT323 12px Midnight Lot text reading 'REVVLOT GUESTBOOK ENTRY' left-aligned, plus three fake window control dots (close/min/max) as 10px circles in Sunshine Honk, AOL Hot Magenta, and Netscape Lime on the right side of the title bar.
- Panel body: Bevel White (#E8E8E8) background, 24px padding.
- Oversized opening quote mark: AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC), Arial Black or Georgia, 96px, positioned at top-left of panel body, overlapping the title bar bottom edge by ~16px — a typographic stunt that breaks the panel boundary.
- Quote text: Verdana, 14px, #222222 (near-black for legibility on Bevel White), 1.7 line-height, indented 48px from left to clear the quote mark.
- Star rating: 5 Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) star characters (★★★★★) in Verdana 16px, 12px top margin below quote.
- Reviewer name: Verdana, 13px, Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF), underlined (functional link anchor tradition), 6px top margin. City in Verdana 12px Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) on same line, separated by an em dash.

The three panels are staggered: left panel top-aligned, center panel shifted 32px down, right panel top-aligned. This creates visual rhythm without symmetry.

Bottom of section: A hit-counter widget in VT323 14px Netscape Lime (#00FF33) reads 'VISITORS: 00847,291' and is centered below the panels with 32px top margin, styled as a recessed inset box with Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) border — the canonical 90s web hit counter as a trust/credibility signal.

No CTA in this section. The section closes with a rainbow rule divider (6 stripes × 3px) running full-width before the footer.

Responsive: 3-column → 1-column stacked on mobile. Vertical offset removed on mobile. Browser chrome panels maintain full treatment at all sizes. Quote marks scale from 96px → 64px on mobile.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
PAGE: Browse Inventory — RevvLot retro-90s used car marketplace listing page.

SECTION RHYTHM & SEQUENCE:
The page opens with a dense, wallpaper-textured masthead (Section 1) that announces the inventory count in an oversized typographic blast — no split-hero softness, just raw display type on a tiled background. Section 2 immediately drops into a beveled Windows-95-style filter panel dashboard — a raised-chrome control strip that reads like a Netscape toolbar, packed with labeled filter widgets in a grid. Section 3 is the inventory card grid — the densest, tallest section, using a 3-column card layout on a deep Midnight Lot background, each card styled as a beveled raised panel with pixel-badge overlaps. Section 4 breaks the density with a two-column comparison panel — a hard-split table-style layout with a Sunshine Honk vs. Dial-Up Sky color block divide, evoking a 90s magazine comparison chart. Section 5 closes with a full-bleed AOL Hot Magenta CTA panel — saturated, loud, centered by necessity (it's a conversion close), with a marquee-strip eyebrow and a single oversized CTA button.

SIGNATURE MOMENT:
The page's signature moment lives in Section 1: the inventory count "12,400" is rendered in Arial Black at approximately 160–180px, in Netscape Lime (#00FF33), with a hard 4px AOL Hot Magenta text-stroke outline and a deep drop shadow in Midnight Lot. The number bleeds off the right edge of the viewport at full width — it does not sit politely inside a container. Behind it, the pixel-art car silhouette halftone pattern tiles wall-to-wall as the section background in GeoCities Grape (#6600CC). The headline text "RIDES. ONE HONEST LOT." sits in a second line of Arial Black in Bevel White at 56px, left-aligned and partially overlapping the oversized number. This is a purely 90s web-maximalist move: the number-as-hero, the color clash, the bleed — all traceable to GeoCities-era page design where numbers and stats were treated as visual boasts.

COLOR & SURFACE LOGIC:
- Section 1: GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) background, tiled pattern, Netscape Lime + Bevel White type.
- Section 2: Bevel White (#E8E8E8) raised panel surface with Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) beveled inset borders — full Windows 95 / Netscape toolbar energy. Filter labels in Midnight Lot text.
- Section 3: Midnight Lot (#110022) background, card surfaces in Bevel White with Browser Chrome Gray bevel borders. Badge chips in Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) with Midnight Lot text. Card prices in Netscape Lime. Hyperlink CTAs in Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) with underlines.
- Section 4: Hard two-column split — left column in Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) background, right column in Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) background. Both with Midnight Lot text. A Browser Chrome Gray vertical rule divides them. Metric values in Arial Black.
- Section 5: Full-bleed AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) background, Bevel White headline, Netscape Lime CTA button with Midnight Lot label text.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
- Display: Arial Black ALL-CAPS at 160–180px for the oversized inventory count (Section 1 signature). H1 at 56–72px in Arial Black ALL-CAPS throughout. H2 at 36–48px. H3 at 24–30px.
- Body: Verdana 14–16px at 1.65 line-height in near-white (#E8E8E8) on dark surfaces, Midnight Lot on light surfaces.
- Accent: VT323 at 12–14px for hit-counter readouts, badge labels, eyebrow tags, metadata timestamps, and filter type labels.
- Eyebrows: VT323 in Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) ALL-CAPS on dark surfaces; in GeoCities Grape on light surfaces.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
Sections 1 and 3 are dense and tight — minimal padding, maximum content pressure. Section 2 is medium-density — structured filter grid with clear internal spacing but no generous breathing room. Section 4 is deliberately sparse inside each column — the color blocks do the visual work. Section 5 is the sparsest — centered, single CTA, maximum punch from color alone.

RAINBOW RULE DIVIDERS:
Between every section transition, a full-width 4px rainbow rule divider (cycling through Netscape Lime → AOL Hot Magenta → Dial-Up Sky → Sunshine Honk segments) acts as a structural ornamental device, not a decorative afterthought. These dividers are a recurring structural motif across the page.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Mobile: The oversized 12,400 number scales down to ~80px but still bleeds off-edge. Filter grid collapses to single-column stacked dropdowns. Inventory cards stack to 1-column. Comparison panel stacks Sedan above SUV with full-width color blocks. CTA panel remains full-bleed.
- Tablet: Inventory cards go 2-column. Filter grid goes 2-column. Comparison panel remains side-by-side.
- Desktop: Full 3-column inventory grid, 4-column filter grid, side-by-side comparison.

CROSS-PAGE FIT:
This page shares the GeoCities Grape / Midnight Lot dark portal aesthetic established on the Home page, carries the beveled panel system from the shared design system, and introduces the filter dashboard as a new structural module unique to the listing role. The rainbow rule dividers and VT323 eyebrows maintain cross-page rhythm.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION 1 — PAGE HEADER (Masthead / Signature Moment).

Surface & Background: Full-bleed section, GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) background. The pixel-art car silhouette halftone pattern (tiny repeating pixel-car silhouettes in a dot-halftone arrangement) tiles wall-to-wall behind all content as a CSS/image background-repeat texture. The pattern should be visible but slightly darkened — apply a 30% Midnight Lot (#110022) overlay on top of the tile so the type remains legible while the texture breathes through.

Signature Moment — Oversized Inventory Count: The number '12,400' is rendered in Arial Black at 160–180px, ALL-CAPS weight, in Netscape Lime (#00FF33), with a hard 4px AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) text-stroke outline and a Midnight Lot drop-shadow offset at 6px right / 6px down. This number is left-aligned at the container's left edge and intentionally bleeds off the right side of the viewport — it does not wrap, it does not shrink to fit. It sits in the top half of the section, approximately 48px from the top padding edge.

Headline Treatment: Directly below (or overlapping the bottom of) the oversized number, the word 'RIDES. ONE HONEST LOT.' appears in Arial Black at 56px, Bevel White (#E8E8E8), ALL-CAPS, left-aligned. It sits on its own line and may slightly overlap the descending baseline of the large number for layered density. No subheadline is used — the number and headline together form the complete message.

Eyebrow: Above the oversized number, the eyebrow 'THE INVENTORY' is set in VT323 at 14px, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00), ALL-CAPS, left-aligned, with a 2px Sunshine Honk underline. Treat it as a terminal-style label tag.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
**RevvLot — Vehicle Specs Page: Full Page Design Direction**

**Page Role & Rhythm Overview**
This is a deep-dive detail page — the buyer has already shown intent and needs to be drowned in trustworthy data, not coaxed with marketing fluff. The page runs 5 sections in a deliberate dense→denser→explosive→narrative→closing rhythm: a punchy header dashboard card, a tightly-packed mechanical specs grid, a full-bleed inspection scorecard "signature moment," a vertical timeline history scroll, and a closing CTA strip. No two sections share the same skeleton or surface treatment. The alternation is aggressive: dark purple → near-black grid → full-bleed magenta explosion → dark purple with lime timeline nodes → Midnight Lot CTA close.

**Signature Moment — Section 3 (Inspection Stats)**
The page's single most memorable visual move lives in the inspection stats section: a FULL-BLEED AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) panel that breaks the purple/dark rhythm entirely, with the headline "THIS CAR PASSED." rendered in Arial Black at ~96px ALL-CAPS in Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) with a hard black drop-shadow, bleeding off the left edge of the grid. The retro radial gauge / pixel-bar chart asset floats inside a beveled Bevel White (#E8E8E8) inset panel that overlaps the magenta background, crossing the section boundary line. This is a pure GeoCities maximalist moment — a saturated color block that screams "LOOK AT THIS SCORE" using the aesthetic's own visual aggression, not a modern SaaS callout box. Stat values are rendered in VT323 at oversized 48px (the one exception to the "accent only" rule for VT323 — justified here because these are literal dashboard readout numbers, not display headlines).

**Color & Surface Progression**
- Section 1 (Header): GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) background with a Midnight Lot (#110022) tiled-wallpaper texture overlay at low opacity. Bevel White raised panel for the dashboard card asset.
- Section 2 (Specs Grid): Midnight Lot (#110022) background. Grid cells use Bevel White (#E8E8E8) panel faces with Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) beveled inset borders — classic Windows 95 panel feel. Category eyebrow labels in Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00).
- Section 3 (Stats): Full-bleed AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) — the signature break. No section background alternation — this is a deliberate violent color interrupt.
- Section 4 (Timeline): GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) background. Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) vertical timeline spine line. Lime (#00FF33) circular node markers. Bevel White text panels.
- Section 5 (CTA): Midnight Lot (#110022) background with a rainbow rule divider at the top edge. Netscape Lime (#00FF33) primary CTA button with beveled 3D treatment.

**Typography Hierarchy**
- Page headline (Section 1): Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, ~56px, AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) on Grape background, hard text-shadow in Midnight Lot.
- Section 2 grid cell titles: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, ~20px, Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF).
- Section 3 headline: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, ~96px, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00), bleeds left off-grid — the typographic stunt.
- Section 3 stat values: VT323, 48px, Midnight Lot (#110022) — justified exception for dashboard readout numbers.
- Section 4 timeline dates: Arial Black, ~18px, Netscape Lime (#00FF33).
- Section 4 body: Verdana, 14px, Bevel White (#E8E8E8).
- Section 5 headline: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, ~48px, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00).
- All eyebrow labels: VT323, 13px, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) — consistent across page.

**Density & Whitespace Logic**
Section 1 is moderately padded (60px vertical) — it's an introduction, not a data dump. Section 2 is dense — tight 24px internal grid gaps, small cell padding, maximizing the "specs table" feel. Section 3 is explosively padded (80px vertical) to let the magenta breathe and the oversized type land. Section 4 uses generous vertical spacing between timeline nodes (48px gap) to let the narrative unfold. Section 5 is compact (48px vertical) — a closing strip, not a full section.

**Structural Ornament**
Rainbow rule dividers (6px height, CSS gradient across all 6 palette accent colors) appear between every section transition as a structural device — they are not decorative afterthoughts but literal section separators that reinforce the GeoCities-era page anatomy. An 88×31 "INSPECTED & CERTIFIED" badge sticker in Sunshine Honk with a Hot Magenta border appears in the top-right corner of Section 1's dashboard card. A hit-counter widget in VT323 appears in the footer area of Section 1 ("VIEWS TODAY: 00847").

**Responsive Behavior**
- Mobile (<768px): All multi-column grids collapse to single column. The Section 3 oversized headline scales down to ~52px but retains the left-bleed treatment. Timeline remains vertical (already single-column). Beveled panel borders maintain 2px inset treatment at all breakpoints.
- Tablet (768–1024px): Section 2 grid goes 2-column. Section 3 chart panel stacks below the stat callouts.
- Desktop (1024px+): Full layouts as described per section below.

**Cross-Page Consistency**
This page shares the GeoCities Grape / Midnight Lot surface alternation established on the Home page, uses the same rainbow rule dividers and 88×31 badge motifs, and maintains the VT323 eyebrow / hit-counter system. The beveled Bevel White panels echo the Browse Inventory card treatment. The Dial-Up Sky hyperlink color appears on all inline text links. This page is the most data-dense in the site — it earns that density because the buyer is here to verify, not to be sold.

## RevvLot — Photo Gallery Page: Full Design Direction

### Page Role & Tone
This is the visual confidence page — the buyer has already read specs and now needs to *see* the car with their own eyes. The design must feel like opening a GeoCities photo album from 1998 that somehow got turbocharged: beveled panels, tiled wallpaper, rainbow rule dividers, and category tabs that feel ripped from an old Netscape browser window. Every section should feel like a different "room" in a 90s web portal, yet all unified by the shared dark-purple/lime/magenta palette.

### Signature Moment
**The Signature Moment lives in the Exterior Gallery section (Section 2): a full-bleed, top-down pixel-art orthographic diagram of the sedan — rendered in AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) outlines on a deep Midnight Lot (#110022) surface — that BLEEDS across the full page width and sits BEHIND a transparent overlay of photo-count badges and category labels.** The diagram is oversized, spanning the full 12-column grid, with numbered hotspot markers in Netscape Lime (#00FF33) punching out of the magenta line art. This is unmistakably 90s-web energy: a technical diagram treated as a hero image, overlaid with beveled badge widgets like stickers slapped onto a poster. No modern SaaS page would do this. It belongs to this aesthetic because GeoCities users loved putting technical diagrams and pixel art as page centerpieces, and the Dashboard Product layout family calls for data-rich visual modules. The diagram functions structurally — it maps the exterior photo categories spatially — not decoratively.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header** — Dense masthead strip: dark Midnight Lot bar, all-caps Arial Black headline, breadcrumb navigation, two beveled CTA buttons. Compact and directional. Sets the portal-header energy immediately.
2. **Exterior Gallery** — SIGNATURE MOMENT. Full-bleed pixel-art diagram behind the grid. Four photo-category panels arranged in a 2×2 beveled card grid below the diagram. Maximum density and visual aggression.
3. **Interior Gallery** — Side-tabbed layout: a vertical tab rail on the left (Browser-Chrome Gray, beveled) with four category tabs; the active tab's photo grid expands right. Alternates the rhythm from Section 2's full-bleed chaos to a structured dashboard panel feel.
4. **Mechanical Gallery** — Three-column feature panel with retro pixel icons above each column header, dense copy below. Dark GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) surface to break the page's background alternation. Feels like a diagnostic readout panel.
5. **CTA Close** — Centered, high-contrast, full-bleed Midnight Lot panel with a massive Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) numeral "47" dominating the left half and the reserve CTA on the right. Asymmetric typographic stunt. Sparse after the density of Sections 2–4.

### Color & Surface Logic
- **Page background tiling**: The entire page sits on a tiled micro-pattern wallpaper in GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) — a subtle repeating diamond/dot tile at low opacity over the solid purple, visible between sections. This is the page's ground texture.
- **Section surfaces alternate**: Section 1 = Midnight Lot (#110022). Section 2 = Midnight Lot with the magenta diagram bleeding behind. Section 3 = Bevel White (#E8E8E8) panels on a dark Midnight Lot rail. Section 4 = GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) solid. Section 5 = Midnight Lot (#110022).
- **Netscape Lime (#00FF33)** appears on: active states, photo-count badges, hotspot markers, primary CTA buttons, and the "47 Photos" numeral in Section 5.
- **AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC)** appears on: the exterior diagram outlines, rainbow rule dividers between sections, the Section 5 eyebrow label, and badge borders throughout.
- **Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF)** appears on: hyperlinks, metric card borders, tab borders, and the "PHOTO GALLERY" eyebrow labels.
- **Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00)** appears on: photo-count chip labels, the oversized "47" in Section 5, and the "UNDER CONSTRUCTION" motif badge in Section 1.
- **Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0)** appears on: beveled button shadows, panel inset borders, and table row stripes in the side-tab rail.

### Rainbow Rule Dividers
Every section boundary is separated by a full-width rainbow rule divider — a horizontal band of 4px stripes cycling through Netscape Lime → AOL Hot Magenta → Dial-Up Sky → Sunshine Honk. This is a structural device, not decorative trim. It signals section transitions exactly as 90s web pages used <HR> tags with rainbow GIF replacements.

### Typography Hierarchy
- **H1 (Section 1)**: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 64px, Netscape Lime, -0.02em tracking, hard white drop-shadow offset 3px/3px.
- **H2 (Sections 2–4)**: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 40px, alternating between AOL Hot Magenta (Sections 2, 4) and Dial-Up Sky (Section 3).
- **H2 (Section 5)**: Arial Black, ALL-CAPS, 52px, Bevel White (#E8E8E8), centered.
- **Eyebrow labels**: VT323 pixel font, 13px, Sunshine Honk or Dial-Up Sky, all-caps, letter-spaced 0.15em — used strictly as small category tags above headlines.
- **Body / descriptions**: Verdana, 14px, 1.65 line-height, Bevel White or Browser Chrome Gray on dark surfaces.
- **Photo-count badges**: VT323, 12px, Netscape Lime text on Midnight Lot pill badges with Netscape Lime border.
- **Oversized "47" in Section 5**: Arial Black, 200px, Sunshine Honk, positioned left-half of the panel, partially cropped by the right edge of its column — a typographic bleed move.

### Density / Whitespace Logic
- Sections 1 and 5 are relatively sparse — tight vertical padding (40px top/bottom), focused on a single action or statement.
- Sections 2, 3, and 4 are dense — photo grids, tab rails, icon columns, and category copy pack the panel tightly with 24px internal gutters between cards.
- The overall rhythm is: TIGHT → DENSE → DENSE → DENSE → SPARSE. This mirrors the user journey: arrive quickly, dig deep into photos, then emerge to a clear decision moment.

### Responsive Behavior
- Mobile (< 768px): The Section 2 pixel-art diagram collapses to a centered 320px wide version above the photo cards; the 2×2 card grid stacks to a single column. The Section 3 side-tab rail collapses to a horizontal scrollable tab strip above the photo grid. Section 4 three-column layout stacks vertically. Section 5 stacks the "47" numeral above the CTA block, both centered.
- Tablet (768–1024px): Section 2 diagram scales to full width at reduced height. Section 3 tab rail stays vertical but narrows. Section 4 goes 3-column. Section 5 maintains the asymmetric split.
- Desktop (> 1024px): Full 12-column grid, all layouts as described in section plans.

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses every color token in the shared palette at least once, applies Arial Black/Verdana/VT323 at their specified scales, and reinforces the beveled-panel, tiled-wallpaper, rainbow-rule, and 88x31-badge visual cues from the aesthetic guidance. It is the most visually documentation-heavy page in the site (photo gallery), so it leans into the Dashboard Product layout family's "data modules and feature panels" structure more than any other page — but always filtered through the 90s web portal lens.

PAGE: Reserve Your Car — RevvLot Conversion Page

OVERVIEW & RHYTHM:
This is the highest-stakes page in the site — a conversion page that must simultaneously feel celebratory (you're almost there!), trustworthy (your money is safe), and urgently retro (GeoCities energy at full amplitude). The five sections alternate between dense dashboard-panel compositions and looser, more breathable trust-building layouts, creating a push-pull rhythm that mirrors the 90s portal aesthetic: information-dense panels interrupted by loud typographic moments.

Section sequence and density logic:
1. PAGE HEADER (sparse → explosive): A full-bleed dark hero with maximum typographic aggression — the signature moment lives here.
2. STORY BLOCK (dense, dashboard-panel): A Windows-95-style raised-panel vehicle recap with itemized line items, mimicking a receipt or invoice widget.
3. CONTACT BLOCK (dense, form-dominant): A two-column layout with a beveled form panel on the left and a sidebar trust reminder on the right, heavy with 90s chrome styling.
4. FEATURE GRID (medium density, grid-structured): A 2×2 grid of beveled trust-badge panels with pixel-art icons, using a contrasting surface color to break the page rhythm.
5. FAQ (dense, accordion-list): A terminal-flavored Q&A block styled like a BBS bulletin board post list, closing with a final aggressive CTA.

SIGNATURE MOMENT:
The signature moment is in Section 1 (Page Header): a full-bleed MARQUEE HEADLINE treatment where the word "LOCK IT IN." is rendered in Arial Black at approximately 96–112px, in AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC), with a hard black text-stroke outline (3px), spanning the full viewport width and intentionally overflowing the left edge by roughly 8–12px — a GeoCities-era "text too big for the page" energy that feels like the browser can barely contain it. This is overlaid on a tiled Midnight Lot (#110022) background with a repeating tiny car-silhouette pattern (CSS-simulated via a subtle opacity watermark grid). The pixel-art "RESERVED" car illustration floats in the upper-right quadrant, partially overlapping the headline — not tucked neatly aside, but crashing into the type. This move is inevitable for the retro_90s_web aesthetic: it's the GeoCities page owner who made the font TOO BIG and loved it.

COLOR & SURFACE USAGE ACROSS SECTIONS:
- Section 1: Midnight Lot (#110022) tiled background, AOL Hot Magenta (#FF00CC) display headline, Netscape Lime (#00FF33) eyebrow and CTA-adjacent text, Bevel White (#E8E8E8) subheadline.
- Section 2: GeoCities Grape (#6600CC) section background, Bevel White (#E8E8E8) raised panel surface for the vehicle recap card, Browser Chrome Gray (#C0C0C0) for beveled borders and inset shadows, Sunshine Honk (#FFFF00) for price callout values, Dial-Up Sky (#00CCFF) for line-item labels.
